name: UCW — the Elimination Chamber unification show

evidence.source: the fed's own invasion promo, delivered on PWE Underground in October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/mortis-v-the-mask-2005-10-10.html)
evidence.note: The Mask's own account of the last UCW show he worked: “The last time I was in a UCW ring, it was announced that there would be an Elimination Chamber match to unify my World Title, and Trent Hawk's Heavyweight Title.”

notes: The last night Ultimate Championship Wrestling ran under its own name, by the only account of it that survives. Whether the announced match ever happened is not recoverable.

name: UCW & UG Present: Carnage

evidence.source: PWE's own UNDERGROUND forum as the board rendered it on 2 November 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/forum-pwe-underground-53.html)
evidence.note: Carried in three threads by its own date — “UCW & UG Present: Carnage 10/23/05”, with match lists for each.

evidence.source: the board's own NEWS panel of 2 November 2005 — held in the workshop and not served
evidence.note: Carries the result of the show's North American Title match in full: “UCW NORTH AMERICAN CHAMPIONSHIP MATCH: THE MASK (C) v. HOLDEN GILMOUR — The Mask and Holden Gilmour made their PPV debut in PWE a great one. They stole the show in this bout for the UCW North American Title. Eventually, it would be the champion who came out with the win, and his title!”

notes: The first card the two promotions co-promoted after PWE bought UCW. The forum carried it in three threads, titled for their own matches — “Tag/Hopkins&Walker/Dozer&Mortis”, “Deep&Breaker/Druc&Brain/HHH&Harris/” and “Holden v The Mask”. One result survives, in the board's own news panel: The Mask retained the North American Title against Holden Gilmour. No document of the show itself was captured, so nothing here is structured as a match.

name: UCW: The Tower

evidence.source: the board's own category index for Pro-Wrestling Entertainment, captured 6 December 2005 and again 3 January 2006 — held in the workshop and not served (c_10.html)
evidence.note: The results forum's own last-post line, first reading “In: UCW: The Tower / By: Joe / Dec 5 2005, 10:45 AM” and then, four weeks later, “In: UCW: The Tower Hour Two / By: Doc / Dec 31 2005, 03:10 PM”.

notes: Posted in two hours, four weeks apart. Neither hour was captured; the show is known only from the line the board's own category index printed for the forum that held it. The earlier citation for this row named the results forum's own topic list, which does not carry the show — corrected at the tier-3 pass of 2026-09-02.
